nom: MAC Hyper Real Serumizer Skin Balancing Hydration Serum

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-combination skin report the serum balances oil while still hydrating, without greasiness (2, 27, 44).
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as a rich but non-greasy fix for flaking and dryness, especially in winter, though a couple still saw flaking/pilling when worn under makeup (8, 19, 46, 50, 60, 65, 67, 72; contrast 3, 4).
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including those with dry patches on nose/chin, say it balances their skin and preps it well for makeup (2, 29, 79).
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several tolerate it well and even find it soothing, but one explicitly warns against it for sensitive skin due to fragrance and one reacted to niacinamide (0, 12, 24, 31 vs 0, 12).
segments.mature: Older reviewers report brighter, firmer, more youthful-looking skin and pair it well with retinoid routines (16, 19, 36, 64).

concerns.aging: Several mature or aging-focused reviewers report firmer, brighter, more youthful-looking skin and reduced fine lines over weeks of use; one specifically credits the routine with softening a fine line by the mouth, though one reviewer saw no noticeable anti-aging effect (16, 17, 24, 34, 36 vs 6).
concerns.dehydration: The great majority of reviewers describe strong, lasting hydration and plumper, softer skin, including those with chronic dryness; a few instead report peeling or flaking, especially without makeup or as the day progresses (5, 8, 39, 45, 65 vs 3, 4).
concerns.redness: Two reviewers with rosacea or general redness/hyperpigmentation report visible calming and reduced redness over months of use (31, 71).
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the serum as strengthening or balancing the skin barrier and reducing sensitivity/irritation over time (31, 53, 65).
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report fading dark spots or hyperpigmentation with regular use over weeks to a couple of months (23, 25, 37, 73, 77).
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers say it does not cause breakouts and some say it helps clear blemishes, but two reviewers report significant breakouts, one tracing it to a hyaluronic-acid sensitivity (1, 13, 15, 23, 30, 57 vs 1, 13).
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report it controls oil and balances dry/oily patches without leaving a greasy residue or oily finish (2, 15, 26, 27, 44).

aspects.libelle: High price relative to amount received
Pilling or flaking under makeup for some

extraits.texte: It's highly fragranced and the travel size pump didn't even work. I do not recommend this if you have sensitive skin. Otherwise it would've been just fine without fragrance. Smh. On My face no thanks. I didn't get this from ulta I got it from mac just to be clear.
I rarely break out from products but this is the first time I break out and its really bad!!! I have acne all over my face now. I don't recommend at all.

extraits.titre: Great unless you have issues with hyaluronic acid...
extraits.texte: I bought this product after it was sampled on me in the store, and it made my skin feel so soft! Unfortunately, I broke out from it and I found out soon after that hyaluronic acid makes me break out. I was really sad I had to discontinue using this, but I'd still recommend it to anyone who doesn't have issues using products containing hyaluronic acid.

Love the MAC serumizer! Makes my skin so soft, smooth & ever so lightly hydrated. Great for a no-makeup day, but mainly I use it as a second step aftee moisturizer in my pre makeup routine. Makeup applies flawlessly over it. Works as an excellent primer too making a perfect base for makeup. Im 43 with dry skin.

extraits.titre: MUST have in my skincare routine!
extraits.texte: This stuff is AMAZING and feels great on the skin! I have very sensitive skin, but it doesn't break me out at all..I use the cream cleanser as step one, then I spray my face with Fix Plus Magic Radiance, then I apply this serum (I never tried the under eye serum) Honestly, I use this face serum all over my face and also under eye, then I apply the balm afterwards..This routine has become a game changer for me..My skin has never looked better! I was hoping not to love this routine because of the cost of using so many products, but I must say, it's worth every penny and a little goes a long way with all of these skincare products, so it's definitely worth it..The craziest thing I've experienced with this product (and I swear, this isn't sponsored at all..lol) I had a very small line by my mouth that was driving me crazy..I even tried filler to get rid of it and it still showed..After my Mac skincare routine, the line is completely gone! I was truly amazed..I am not sure if it's the cleanser, the fix plus, the serum or the balm that got rid of it, but I couldn't be happier about that! If you are on the fence about purchasing Mac's skincare, just do it! I promise you'll thank me later! Thank you so much Mac!

I have sensitive skin w/rosacea. Been using the same products for years and thought my skin was as good as it could to get. While in Ulta, I was getting color matched for MAC foundation and the MUA put this on first and I almost heard my skin sigh.
I love this stuff. I struggle with hormonal acne, dry skin, and redness. This serum takes it all away and my skin feels so smooth. Love the smell and it has all the ingredients you need in one serum.
